name: pilot-multi-region-content-sync-setup
title: 多区域内容同步设置
description:
Deploy a multi-region content distribution system with 4 agents.
Use this skill when: 1. User wants to sync content across geographic regions 2. User is configuring an origin or edge node for content distribution 3. User asks about CDN-like content replication between agents
Do NOT use this skill when: - User wants to sync a single file (use pilot-sync instead) - User wants a one-shot file transfer (use pilot-share instead)
